#BTC.D Market Analysis

BTC.D is at 60.62% on the 8h, stalling right under the upper trendline of the rising wedge from late May after a wick into it near 60.95% got rejected. Altcoins have been bleeding for weeks as dominance climbed, and this ceiling is now the line that decides whether that pressure keeps building.

Bull case: break above the wedge top near 60.95% and push to fresh highs, keeping altcoins under heavy pressure.
Bear case: reject here and fade below 60.40%, giving altcoins room to breathe as dominance pulls back toward 60.00%.

Wedge top caps dominance and alts finally get relief, or does BTC keep draining the market?

#ETH/BTC Market Analysis

ETH/BTC is at 0.02933 on the daily, pinned right on the rising trendline from the June lows. A string of lower highs since early October has pushed price into the line, and the room to bounce is running out fast.

Bull case: hold the trendline and reclaim 0.0297, opening a path back toward 0.0301 and the 0.0310 zone.
Bear case: lose 0.0289 on a daily close and break the trendline, exposing 0.0281 and the 0.0277 July base.

Trendline sparks an ETH comeback, or does BTC keep winning this pair?
